shared_elements: dense repeated surface patterning (scales, curls) used as infill
justification: Both depict human figures carved in relief with headgear and dense decorative infill, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows a single frontal figure enveloped in scrolling ornament and glyph-like masks on a vertical shaft, while B shows a horizontal procession of profile figures leading horned rams past a stylised tree. There is no shared relationship, posture, attribute or compositional scheme; the rendering conventions (curvilinear all-over ornament vs. clean profile naturalism with scale-patterned fleece) also differ fundamentally.
